entries.title: Can a WOOL Scarf Keep Ice Cream COLD? The Great Ice Cream Rescue

moments.what: The problem: the party is in 20 minutes and it is 33 degrees
Pick the fix: run faster, fan it, or wrap it in wool?
Fix 1: Pip runs. Heat flows out of his tummy into the ice cream
Look closer: warm air at 33 degrees, ice cream at minus 18
Heat flows from a hotter place to a colder place
Fix 3: wrap the box in a wool scarf
Journey: be a bit of air trapped in the wool
Wool and trapped air are poor conductors of heat
A fair test: no wrapper, a plastic bag or wool
The rescue, and a magnet at the drain
The party: is the ice cream still frozen?
The P3 year, and coming up in Primary 4
